shared_elements: incised linear ornament on the body/garment
justification: Both depict human-like figures with distinct headgear and patterned surfaces on the body, and both include arms/hands laid against the torso, but that is about as generic as figural carving gets. A is a single frontal, massive, highly schematic figure covered with abstract discs and bands, while B is a naturalistic procession of bearded men in strict profile wearing draped robes and tall caps, touching one another and carrying handled objects — utterly different conventions of proportion, viewpoint and composition.
